messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — starting the v2 edge rollout now for /api/v2/edge (11:00 PT). Observed a weird signal attenuation on a small subset of mobile clients in staging. Keeping a tight watch.

deploy-bot: deploy started by marta — v2-edge rollout group=50% region=us-west-2 canary=gradual

kai: which metric surface showed the attenuation? request drops or header munging?

marta: looks like partial header drop when clients retry through older proxies — X-Client-Signal sometimes missing, falling back to noisy routing. Not all clients.

samir: ok. mitigation plan: (1) pin known-legacy mobile SDKs to v1 via client-pin API, (2) enable hotpatch header-mirror on gateways for a 5m window, (3) hold or rollback if error% > 2% for 10m.

ryan: how do I pin programmatically? share the command and I'll run for the top 10 tenant IDs.

marta: use the admin pin endpoint — example: 
```
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.internal/pins" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"<TENANT>", "route":"/api/edge", "pin_version":"v1"}'
```
I'll paste a list of the top-10 tenant IDs in a sec.

deploy-bot: canary health: latency_p50=60ms latency_p95=220ms error_rate=0.4% throughput=180r/s

julie: hotpatch header-mirror looks low-risk. How do we enable it? Is there a rollout flag?

marta: ops-bot will toggle the gateway flag. command: `ops-bot toggle header_mirror=true scope=edge-proxies duration=5m`

ops-bot: acknowledged. scheduling header_mirror toggle for edge-proxies now (5m). Will post completion.

samir: locking in rollback trigger: if error_rate >= 2.0% sustained for 10m OR if client-compat-failures spike > 50 in 5m, we rollback and pin mobile-sdk to v1 cluster-wide. @marta please confirm.

marta: confirmed. also gating release notes push until we validate telemetry for 30m. I'd rather delay notes than backfill.

ryan: ran the pin for tenant ids A12, B34, C56 — response 200 for all.

deploy-bot: header_mirror toggle completed by ops-bot — active for 5m.

deploy-bot: canary update: latency_p95=210ms error_rate=0.6% throughput=175r/s. minor noise but stable.

julie: telemetry: client-compat-failures=8 in last 10m, all from SDK 2.1.0 on older proxies.

samir: that's below threshold. keep pins in place for 1h and observe. I'll prepare rollback runbook just in case.

marta: agreed. if anything trends up, we hit rollback-runbook -> run `deploy-bot rollback v2-edge` and ops will unroll header mirrors.

ryan: noted. will keep running tenant pins until we hit the top 50.

deploy-bot: scheduled check-ins every 5m for the next 30m. will post metrics.

marta: thanks everyone — leaving monitoring on. ping me if you see client drops or missing X-Client-Signal. :eyes:
